vehicle_specificity.statement: The common-task route and wind/current magnitude ranges are Surveyor-specific.
vehicle_specificity.derivation: 90 s target median transit time divided by the measured 66.325 s pre-rescale median transit time.
vehicle_specificity.transfer_guard: Vehicle B, Vehicle C, or any later vehicle must receive its own measured-capability rescale check. The Surveyor route and disturbance envelope must not be assumed transferable.

methods_history.statement: Calibration exposed a wrong reference-vehicle binding, after which the Surveyor was modeled from published geometry and mass using a documented two-body approximation. A generic yaw-authority bound then exposed a coupled allocator defect; the allocator was corrected using a yaw-first feasible-envelope projection. Finally, route and disturbance magnitudes were rescaled once from measured Surveyor transit capability before the terminal criterion and C3 thresholds were frozen.
methods_history.interpretation: These corrections are methodological provenance and should be stated in the paper rather than omitted.
limitations: Surveyor hull geometry and inertia remain documented approximations rather than manufacturer CAD or measured mass properties.
The 0.35 s actuator lag is borrowed from a generic fallback and is not Surveyor-specific.
Vehicle-specific task scaling limits unverified transfer of this difficulty envelope to other vehicles.
